value.name: introduce serrano house
value.description: The scene establishes the Serrano house as an old, long-standing home in Spring Garden.
evidence: The Serrano house stood on a block in Spring Garden where the trees were old enough to have learned to grow around the streetlamps, and the bricks had been laid before anyone living had been born.

value.name: reveal estela's reading window
value.description: Asha observes the second-floor bay window associated with Estela Serrano's habit of reading there in life.
evidence: From the sidewalk Asha could see the bay window on the second floor where, according to the obituary, Estela Serrano had liked to read in the afternoons until the last winter of her life, when the stairs became a country she could no longer cross alone.

value.name: notice open shutters
value.description: Asha sees that the shutters on the upstairs window are still open, implying someone inside has not closed them.
evidence: The shutters on that window were still open.
Whoever was inside had not yet learned to close a dead woman's curtains.

value.name: arrive after funeral
value.description: The narration places the visit on Tuesday, one week after Estela's funeral.
evidence: It was Tuesday, the week after the funeral.
value.time_hint: Tuesday, the week after the funeral

value.name: bring case file
value.description: Asha arrives carrying a leather portfolio containing the file, signaling a formal meeting she expects to go badly.
evidence: Asha had brought the file in a leather portfolio she carried only when she expected a meeting to go badly.

value.name: invoke father's advice
value.description: The portfolio's origin and Asha's father's advice reveal her inherited professional habits and family background.
evidence: The portfolio had belonged to her father, who had also been an attorney, and who had told her once that the only thing worth inheriting was a habit of taking notes when other people were performing.

value.name: ring doorbell
value.description: Asha climbs the stoop and presses the doorbell to announce her arrival.
evidence: She climbed the stoop in her low heels and pressed the brass button beside the door.
Somewhere inside, a bell with a real clapper rang.

value.name: rosa answers door
value.description: Rosa opens the door instead of the people Asha expected to meet.

value.name: expect different greeters
value.description: Asha is surprised that the housekeeper answers, since she had expected Daniel or Lucia.
evidence: Asha had not expected the housekeeper.
She had expected Daniel, who had called twice that morning, or Lucia, who had not called at all but whose name appeared in the file as a current resident.

value.name: describe rosa's presence
value.description: Rosa is described as an older, long-serving housekeeper whose appearance suggests years of routine and discipline.
evidence: Instead there was a woman in her late sixties in a navy cardigan, hair pulled back in a way that suggested it had been pulled back in exactly that way every morning for forty years.
